description: Look up official FIDES glossary definitions for the terminology used across the catalogs and filters (credential formats such as SD-JWT-VC and mDL/mDoc, interaction modes such as proximity and remote, interoperability profiles, issuance/presentation protocols, DID methods, key storage, etc.). Call with no arguments to retrieve the complete glossary, or pass specific `terms` to define just those. Each definition includes a `detailUrl` to its entry on the FIDES glossary page — cite that as the source. Use this for conceptual questions like 'what is the proximity flow?' or 'which credential formats are there?'.

terms.description: Optional list of specific terms to define (case-insensitive), e.g. ['proximity', 'SD-JWT-VC', 'OpenID4VP']. Omit to return the full FIDES glossary (useful for questions like 'which credential formats exist?').

name: explain_terms
